turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Sam, it's Maya from Hypersale.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Sam Whitfield. I have fifteen minutes, go ahead.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Repetition gets expensive fast, and our AI voice role plays with quote backscoring help managers spot improvement before quota time is now still okay?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Why is this worth forty-eight thousand dollars?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: The value is catching weak messaging before it costs pipeline or drives reps out.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: I need a number. How much faster do reps ramp, or how many fewer churn?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Reps get realistic AI buyer practice, and managers get weekly progress scoring tied to exact quotes.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: What’s the quantified impact on ramp time or attrition? Give me a number.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I don't want to invent a universal number. It varies by team.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Then give me a range—what’s the typical improvement in months or percentage?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Could we run a 30-day pilot with one team, measure ramp indicators, and then review the business case?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: I’ll consider a pilot, but we need a discount first. What can you offer?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Thanks for your time.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: I’m still waiting on that discount. What’s the new number?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I can bring the annual price to $43,200, contingent on all 40 reps and an annual commitment after

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Still high. We need to get closer to thirty-five thousand. What's your next best?

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Can we schedule the 30-day pilot and business case review?

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Give me a firm date for that business-case review, and we’ll talk next steps.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Thanks for your time.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Send me the business case and we’ll take it from there.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: I'll send the business case today, including the 30-day pilot and the $43,200 annual option for all 40 reps I'll schedule our review for Thursday at 2 p.m. Your time.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Understood. I’ll look out for it. Let’s see how the numbers line up on Thursday.
